message.content:
The screenshot reports a **CUDA OutOfMemoryError** ("torch.OutOfMemoryError: CUDA out of memory").

The failure is explained by memory figures: the code tried to allocate **640.00 MiB**, but **GPU 0 has 12.00 GiB total, of which 96.00 MiB is free**, while the **process holds 11.62 GiB**. With only 96 MiB free against a 640 MiB allocation, the GPU ran out of memory, causing the OutOfMemoryError.
